executiveSummary.description: Applied AWS cloud readiness transformations across the .NET backend and Angular frontend of SquidexBasicrun2. Fixed hard-coded configuration, secrets, file system operations, synchronous blocking calls, XSS vulnerabilities, CSP headers, WebSocket configuration, and more. The project targets .NET 10.0 but only .NET 8 SDK is available, so the build cannot be compiled or tested here. Many blockers in build tools, test files, and bundled third-party libraries could not be fixed. Plaintext secrets found in backend/src/Squidex/appsettings.json lines 952-953 (Twitter clientId/clientSecret) were left as-is as no blocker names them.

rulesResults.ruleName: Multiple CSS Files Not Concatenated or HTTP/2
CSS Custom Properties Without Fallback Values
Razor View Caching on Local Memory
Blazor Server WebSocket Behind Cloud Load Balancer
wwwroot Static Files Without CDN Integration
Static File Middleware Without Cache Headers
Blazor WASM API Calls Without Retry Policy
Razor View Compilation at Runtime in Cloud
Windows Authentication in Web Forms Cloud
External Scripts Without SRI on CDN
Missing CSP Meta Tag in HTML
Missing DNS Prefetch for Cloud API Domains
